title: KEYBOARD CHIP CLEARS THE RAID SCORE
why: The paired p2 pictures showed keyboard covering 0 sp and the 4k critic found tiny text. Keep his 3.5 c marker and its focus rule. Watch: with two windows, the keyboard chip sits clear of the score. LOCAL: no linked review.
now: The raid keyboard chip sits below the drawn score, aligned at its left edge, with text at 80 percent of the score size and padding that follows the rail scale. The Undercroft keeps its top-centre chip.
